guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：共軛焦顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Confocal microscopy
guides.concept: 從點照明與點偵測的共軛關係推導針孔為何能排除離焦光，用艾里單位把針孔直徑、橫向解析度與光學切片厚度連起來，再把螢光光子預算、振鏡掃描時序、偵測器死時間、折射率失配與奈奎斯特取樣整合成一台可驗收的雷射掃描共軛焦顯微鏡。
guides.conceptEn: Derive from the conjugate relation of point illumination and point detection why a pinhole rejects out-of-focus light, use Airy units to tie pinhole diameter to lateral resolution and optical-section thickness, then integrate the fluorescence photon budget, galvanometer timing, detector dead time, refractive-index mismatch and Nyquist sampling into an acceptable laser-scanning confocal microscope.
procedure: 共軛焦顯微鏡把雷射聚成一個繞射極限光點照明樣品，並在偵測路徑上與焦點共軛的位置放一個針孔；焦平面上的螢光成像在針孔中心通過，離焦平面的螢光在針孔處散成大斑而大部分被擋掉。系統點擴散函數是照明與偵測點擴散函數的乘積，因此橫向解析度略優於寬場，而沿光軸的訊號隨離焦距離快速衰減，形成光學切片。針孔直徑以艾里單位（AU）表示，1 AU 等於艾里斑第一暗環的直徑。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

螢光分子吸收激發光子後在奈秒內放出較長波長的光子，激發與發射的波長差（Stokes 位移）讓二向色鏡與發射濾鏡能把激發光擋掉。每個分子的發射速率受吸收截面、激發強度與激發態壽命限制，接近飽和強度時再加雷射功率只會加速光漂白。共軛焦的像素停留時間只有微秒，收集立體角、光學穿透率與偵測器量子效率又把到達偵測器的光子再砍一個數量級，因此每像素常只有數十個光子，散粒雜訊主導影像品質。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「螢光激發與光子計數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

一對振鏡在物鏡後焦面的共軛位置偏轉光束，掃描透鏡與管鏡把角度轉成樣品面上的位置；振鏡在每條掃描線末端需要減速與回程，所以有效停留時間小於幀時間除以像素數。共振掃描器以固定頻率正弦掃描，速度快但每像素的停留時間只有數十奈秒，光子數大幅減少。物鏡的焦距（管鏡焦距除以放大率）與掃描半角決定最大視場，像素尺寸則由視場除以像素數決定，要達到奈奎斯特條件必須小於橫向半高寬的一半。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「振鏡掃描器與掃描透鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

針孔是可變直徑的機械光闌，必須精確對準到偵測光路的共軛焦點，橫向偏差超過十分之一艾里單位就會損失訊號並使切片不對稱。偵測器從多鹼光電倍增管進展到 GaAsP 光陰極與混合式偵測器，量子效率從約 20% 提升到 40% 以上；光子計數模式消除增益雜訊，但每個脈衝後有死時間，計數率高時會漏計，需要修正或降低功率。光譜偵測以稜鏡或光柵把發射光分散到多陽極偵測器上，容許多染料的線性拆分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「GaAsP 偵測器與針孔機構」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

校正分三個層次：橫向比例尺用已知週期的格線標板；三維點擴散函數用次解析度螢光珠，量半高寬並與理論比較以判斷物鏡、針孔與對準狀態；多通道配準用多色螢光珠量各波長之間的橫向與軸向偏移。物鏡的軸向色差在 488 與 640 nm 之間常有一到數百奈米，若不校正，雙色共定位會出現假陽性或假陰性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「螢光珠 PSF 與格線標板」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

油鏡設計用於折射率 1.518 的介質，當焦點進入折射率 1.33 的水性樣品時，光線在蓋玻片界面折射，焦點移動量小於載物台位移，影像在 z 方向被拉長；同時邊緣光線與近軸光線的焦點分離，產生隨深度增加的球差，軸向點擴散函數變寬、峰值下降。軸向量測的誤差預算因此包含比例因子（系統誤差）、球差造成的半高寬展寬、z 步進的量化與載物台重複性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「折射率失配與軸向比例」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整合階段要把雷射合併與 AOTF 功率控制、掃描時序、針孔、偵測器與 z 驅動統一在一個擷取流程裡，並依奈奎斯特條件決定 x、y、z 取樣。共軛焦在擷取每一層時，整個雙錐照明體積都被曝光，所以厚樣品的每個體素會被照射到次數等於層數，劑量管理必須把層數、通道數與幀平均一起算進去；時序影像還要在訊號雜訊比與漂白之間決定幀間隔。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Z 疊層時序與雷射劑量表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收以測試矩陣進行：每個物鏡的三維點擴散函數、視場照度均勻性、通道配準、每條雷射線在樣品面的功率與穩定度、偵測器線性與死時間、載物台與 z 驅動重複性。每項設定允收門檻並附量測方法，結果與校正檔、韌體與軟體版本一起歸檔；交接文件還需記載針孔對準基準、AOTF 功率對照表與已知限制（例如深層水性樣品需水鏡），使後續使用者能判斷系統狀態是否仍在驗收範圍內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收矩陣與校正檔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A confocal microscope focuses the laser to a diffraction-limited spot and places a pinhole in the detection path at a position conjugate to that focus; fluorescence from the focal plane passes through the pinhole centre, while light from out-of-focus planes spreads into a large patch at the pinhole and is mostly blocked. The system point-spread function is the product of the illumination and detection functions, so lateral resolution is slightly better than widefield and the axial signal decays quickly with defocus, producing an optical section. Pinhole diameter is quoted in Airy units, 1 AU being the diameter of the first dark ring of the Airy disc. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A fluorophore absorbs an excitation photon and within nanoseconds emits a longer-wavelength photon; the excitation-emission wavelength gap (Stokes shift) lets a dichroic and an emission filter block the excitation light. Each molecule's emission rate is limited by absorption cross-section, excitation intensity and excited-state lifetime, and near the saturation intensity more laser power only accelerates photobleaching. Confocal pixel dwell times are microseconds, and collection solid angle, optical transmission and detector quantum efficiency cut the photons reaching the detector by another order of magnitude, so a pixel often holds only tens of photons and shot noise governs image quality. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fluorescence excitation and photon count”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A galvanometer pair deflects the beam at a plane conjugate to the objective back focal plane, and the scan lens and tube lens convert angle into position on the sample; the mirrors must decelerate and fly back at each line end, so the effective dwell is less than frame time divided by pixel count. A resonant scanner oscillates sinusoidally at a fixed frequency, fast but with only tens of nanoseconds per pixel and far fewer photons. The objective focal length (tube-lens focal length over magnification) and scan half-angle set the maximum field, pixel size is field over pixel count, and Nyquist sampling requires it to be below half the lateral FWHM. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Galvanometer scanners and scan lens”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The pinhole is a variable mechanical aperture that must sit precisely at the conjugate focus of the detection path; a lateral offset above a tenth of an Airy unit loses signal and skews the section. Detectors progressed from multialkali photomultipliers to GaAsP photocathodes and hybrid detectors, raising quantum efficiency from about 20% to above 40%; photon-counting mode removes gain noise but each pulse is followed by a dead time, so high count rates undercount and need correction or lower power. Spectral detection disperses the emission with a prism or grating onto a multi-anode detector, allowing linear unmixing of several dyes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “GaAsP detector and pinhole mechanism”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Calibration has three layers: lateral scale with a grid target of known pitch; the three-dimensional point-spread function with sub-resolution fluorescent beads, measuring FWHM against theory to judge objective, pinhole and alignment; and multichannel registration with multicolour beads to measure lateral and axial offsets between wavelengths. Axial chromatic aberration of an objective between 488 and 640 nm is often one to several hundred nanometres, and without correction two-colour colocalization yields false positives or negatives. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fluorescent-bead PSF and grid target”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An oil objective is designed for a medium of index 1.518; when the focus enters an aqueous sample of index 1.33, rays refract at the coverslip interface, the focus moves less than the stage, and the image is stretched along z; at the same time marginal and paraxial rays focus apart, producing spherical aberration that grows with depth, broadening the axial point-spread function and lowering its peak. The axial error budget therefore holds a scale factor (systematic), aberration-induced broadening, z-step quantization and stage repeatability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Refractive-index mismatch and axial scaling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Integration unifies laser combining with AOTF power control, scan timing, pinhole, detectors and the z-drive in one acquisition pipeline, with x, y and z sampling fixed by Nyquist. Because the whole double-cone illumination volume is exposed while each slice is acquired, every voxel of a thick sample is irradiated as many times as there are slices, so dose management must count slices, channels and frame averaging together; a time series must also balance signal-to-noise against bleaching when choosing the frame interval. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Z-stack timing and laser-dose table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance follows a test matrix: three-dimensional point-spread function per objective, field illumination uniformity, channel registration, power and stability of each laser line at the sample plane, detector linearity and dead time, and stage and z-drive repeatability. Each item carries an acceptance threshold and a measurement method, and results are archived with calibration files and firmware and software versions; the handoff record also lists the pinhole alignment reference, the AOTF power lookup table and known limits such as the need for a water objective in deep aqueous samples, so later users can judge whether the system still sits inside its accepted range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance matrix and calibration files”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 針孔開到 3 AU 以上追求亮度，離焦背景大量進入偵測器，切片厚度增加到數微米，厚樣品的影像退化成接近寬場的模糊疊加。
使用過大的 500 nm 珠子量點擴散函數，量到的半高寬被珠子尺寸撐大，誤判物鏡劣化並送修；或未做色差配準就宣稱兩種蛋白共定位。
pitfallsEn: Opening the pinhole beyond 3 AU for brightness lets a large out-of-focus background reach the detector, section thickness grows to several micrometres, and images of thick samples degrade toward a widefield-like blur.

Measuring the point-spread function with oversized 500 nm beads inflates the FWHM with the bead size, leading to a false diagnosis of objective degradation and an unnecessary repair; or claiming colocalization of two proteins without chromatic registration.

related.title: 複消色差顯微物鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「點照明、點偵測與光學切片」與「點擴散函數、比例尺與色差校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；複消色差顯微物鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Point illumination, point detection and optical sectioning" and "PSF, scale and chromatic calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Apochromatic microscope objectives must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦針孔艾里單位、光學切片厚度、光子預算與雷射掃描系統的校正；複消色差顯微物鏡則以Abbe 極限、二級光譜與部分色散、齊明前鏡組、蓋玻片球差與 PSF 驗證為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on pinhole Airy units, optical-section thickness, photon budgets and calibration of laser-scanning systems; Apochromatic microscope objectives centres on abbe limit, secondary spectrum and partial dispersion, aplanatic front group, cover-glass spherical aberration and PSF validation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」與「物鏡出瞳與數值孔徑」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到複消色差顯微物鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「蓋玻片球差、折射率失配與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc” and “Objective exit pupil and numerical aperture”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Apochromatic microscope objectives, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Cover-glass spherical aberration, index mismatch and the error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 雙光子顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「點照明、點偵測與光學切片」與「點擴散函數、比例尺與色差校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；雙光子顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Point illumination, point detection and optical sectioning" and "PSF, scale and chromatic calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Two-photon microscopy must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦針孔艾里單位、光學切片厚度、光子預算與雷射掃描系統的校正；雙光子顯微鏡則以I² 非線性激發、脈衝寬度與重複率、散射深度與色散預補償的工程預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on pinhole Airy units, optical-section thickness, photon budgets and calibration of laser-scanning systems; Two-photon microscopy centres on engineering budgets for I² nonlinear excitation, pulse width and repetition rate, scattering depth and dispersion precompensation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」與「焦點處的 I² 激發體積」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雙光子顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「散粒雜訊、偵測器雜訊與熱負載預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc” and “I² excitation volume at the focus”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Two-photon microscopy, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Shot noise, detector noise and the heat-load budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 共軛焦顯微鏡
history.text: Marvin Minsky 於 1957 年申請共軛焦掃描顯微鏡專利，以點照明與針孔偵測排除離焦光；1980 年代中期 Amos、White 與 Fordham 等人結合雷射、振鏡與電腦影像，使雷射掃描共軛焦成為生物學標準工具，Zeiss 與 Bio-Rad 隨後推出商用系統。1990 年代轉盤式（Nipkow disk）共軛焦提高了活細胞成像速度，2010 年代的陣列偵測器（如 Airyscan 概念）則在不犧牲訊號下把解析度推過針孔極限。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Marvin Minsky filed the confocal scanning microscope patent in 1957, rejecting out-of-focus light with point illumination and pinhole detection; in the mid-1980s Amos, White, Fordham and others combined lasers, galvanometers and computer imaging to make laser-scanning confocal a standard biological tool, and Zeiss and Bio-Rad soon offered commercial systems. In the 1990s spinning-disk (Nipkow disk) confocals raised live-cell imaging speed, and in the 2010s array detectors such as the Airyscan concept pushed resolution past the pinhole limit without sacrificing signal. This course rebuilds only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「點照明、點偵測與光學切片」到「驗收測試矩陣與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Point illumination, point detection and optical sectioning" through "Acceptance test matrix and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
